title: Settling the Burn-in Gap: Sharp Risk Bounds for Tail-Averaged SGD in Linear Regression
abstract: arXiv:2611.13383v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the excess risk of constant-stepsize online stochastic gradient descent (SGD) with tail-averaging for high-dimensional linear regression. Building on the instance-dependent spectral framework of Zou et al. (2021), we establish matching initialization-explicit upper and lower bounds on the total excess risk of tail-averaged SGD in terms of the population covariance spectrum $\mathbf{H}$ and initialization $\mathbf{w}_0-\mathbf{w}^*$ whenever a trajectory spectral feedback condition holds. Existing analyses exhibit a fundamental gap in the effective variance: the upper bound of Zou et al. (2021) retains an undamped contribution from the initial error in the head eigenspace $\mathbf{I}_{0:k^\dagger}$, whereas their lower bound omits the variance induced by the head initialization altogether. translated_title: 解决预热间隔问题：线性回归中尾平均SGD的尖锐风险界
translated_abstract: 我们研究了恒定步长在线随机梯度下降（SGD）结合尾平均方法在高维线性回归中的超额风险。基于Zou等人（2021）提出的实例相关谱框架，当轨迹谱反馈条件成立时，我们建立了尾平均SGD总超额风险的匹配的、初始化显式的上下界，这些界由总体协方差谱 $\mathbf{H}$ 和初始化误差 $\mathbf{w}_0-\mathbf{w}^*$ 刻画。现有分析在有效方差方面存在一个根本性的差距：Zou等人（2021）的上界在头部特征空间 $\mathbf{I}_{0:k^\dagger}$ 中保留了来自初始误差的未衰减贡献，而他们的下界却完全忽略了头部初始化所诱导的方差。我们证明现有的上界和下界都是宽松的：来自头部初始化的单跳快模式方差贡献……
tldr: 该论文通过建立依赖初始化信息的匹配上下风险界，解决了尾平均SGD分析中头部特征空间初始误差方差贡献的“预热间隔”问题，并证明现有上界和下界均不够紧致。
en_tdlr: This paper settles the "burn-in gap" by establishing matching initialization-explicit upper and lower bounds on the total excess risk of tail-averaged SGD in linear regression, proving that both existing upper and lower bounds are loose regarding the variance contribution from head initialization.
